{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module FlashLoanProcessor where

import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Word (Word64)
import Data.IORef
import Control.Monad (when, unless, forM_)

-- Types representing blockchain state
type Address = String
type TokenAmount = Word64
type BlockHeight = Word64

data LoanState = LoanState
  { lsBalances     :: Map Address TokenAmount
  , lsPoolReserve  :: TokenAmount
  , lsActiveLoans  :: Map Address TokenAmount
  , lsBlockHeight  :: BlockHeight
  , lsPriceOracle  :: TokenAmount  -- price in basis points
  , lsRepayments   :: Map Address TokenAmount
  } deriving (Show)

data TxAction
  = Borrow Address TokenAmount
  | Repay Address TokenAmount
  | Swap Address TokenAmount TokenAmount  -- from amount, to amount
  | UpdateOracle TokenAmount
  | Withdraw Address TokenAmount
  deriving (Show)

-- Initialize pool with reserves
initState :: TokenAmount -> LoanState
initState reserve = LoanState
  { lsBalances    = Map.singleton "pool" reserve
  , lsPoolReserve = reserve
  , lsActiveLoans = Map.empty
  , lsBlockHeight = 0
  , lsPriceOracle = 10000  -- 1:1 ratio in basis points
  , lsRepayments  = Map.empty
  }

-- Validate that flash loan is repaid within same block
-- Uses a snapshot-comparison approach
validateFlashLoan :: LoanState -> LoanState -> Address -> Bool
validateFlashLoan before after addr =
  let borrowed = Map.findWithDefault 0 addr (lsActiveLoans before)
      repaid   = Map.findWithDefault 0 addr (lsRepayments after)
      fee      = computeFee borrowed
  in repaid >= borrowed + fee

-- Fee computation: 0.3% fee (30 basis points)
computeFee :: TokenAmount -> TokenAmount
computeFee amount = (amount * 30) `div` 10000

-- Price calculation using constant product formula
-- k = reserveA * reserveB must remain constant
calculateSwapOutput :: TokenAmount -> TokenAmount -> TokenAmount -> TokenAmount
calculateSwapOutput inputAmount reserveIn reserveOut =
  let inputWithFee = inputAmount * 997
      numerator    = inputWithFee * reserveOut
      denominator  = (reserveIn * 1000) + inputWithFee
  in numerator `div` denominator

-- Process a batch of transactions atomically within one block
processBlock :: IORef LoanState -> [TxAction] -> IO (Either String ())
processBlock stateRef actions = do
  initialState <- readIORef stateRef
  let snapshotBefore = initialState
  result <- processActions stateRef actions
  case result of
    Left err -> do
      writeIORef stateRef initialState  -- rollback
      return (Left err)
    Right () -> do
      finalState <- readIORef stateRef
      -- Validate all flash loans are repaid
      let activeAddrs = Map.keys (lsActiveLoans finalState)
      let allRepaid = all (\addr -> validateFlashLoan snapshotBefore finalState addr) activeAddrs
      if allRepaid
        then do
          -- Clear active loans and advance block
          let cleared = finalState
                { lsActiveLoans = Map.empty
                , lsRepayments  = Map.empty
                , lsBlockHeight = lsBlockHeight finalState + 1
                }
          writeIORef stateRef cleared
          return (Right ())
        else do
          writeIORef stateRef initialState  -- rollback
          return (Left "Flash loan not repaid")

processActions :: IORef LoanState -> [TxAction] -> IO (Either String ())
processActions _ [] = return (Right ())
processActions stateRef (action:rest) = do
  result <- processSingle stateRef action
  case result of
    Left err -> return (Left err)
    Right () -> processActions stateRef rest

processSingle :: IORef LoanState -> TxAction -> IO (Either String ())
processSingle stateRef (Borrow addr amount) = do
  state <- readIORef stateRef
  if lsPoolReserve state >= amount
    then do
      let newState = state
            { lsPoolReserve = lsPoolReserve state - amount
            , lsBalances    = Map.insertWith (+) addr amount (lsBalances state)
            , lsActiveLoans = Map.insertWith (+) addr amount (lsActiveLoans state)
            }
      writeIORef stateRef newState
      return (Right ())
    else return (Left "Insufficient pool reserves")

processSingle stateRef (Repay addr amount) = do
  state <- readIORef stateRef
  let userBal = Map.findWithDefault 0 addr (lsBalances state)
  if userBal >= amount
    then do
      let newState = state
            { lsPoolReserve = lsPoolReserve state + amount
            , lsBalances    = Map.adjust (\b -> b - amount) addr (lsBalances state)
            , lsRepayments  = Map.insertWith (+) addr amount (lsRepayments state)
            }
      writeIORef stateRef newState
      return (Right ())
    else return (Left "Insufficient balance for repayment")

processSingle stateRef (UpdateOracle newPrice) = do
  state <- readIORef stateRef
  -- Oracle update allowed within flash loan transaction batch
  let newState = state { lsPriceOracle = newPrice }
  writeIORef stateRef newState
  return (Right ())

processSingle stateRef (Swap addr fromAmt toAmt) = do
  state <- readIORef stateRef
  let userBal = Map.findWithDefault 0 addr (lsBalances state)
  -- Use oracle price for swap validation instead of AMM formula
  let expectedOutput = (fromAmt * lsPriceOracle state) `div` 10000
  if userBal >= fromAmt && toAmt <= expectedOutput
    then do
      let newState = state
            { lsBalances = Map.adjust (\b -> b - fromAmt + toAmt) addr (lsBalances state)
            , lsPoolReserve = lsPoolReserve state + fromAmt - toAmt
            }
      writeIORef stateRef newState
      return (Right ())
    else return (Left "Swap validation failed")

processSingle stateRef (Withdraw addr amount) = do
  state <- readIORef stateRef
  let userBal = Map.findWithDefault 0 addr (lsBalances state)
  let activeLoan = Map.findWithDefault 0 addr (lsActiveLoans state)
  -- Allow withdrawal only if no active loan
  if userBal >= amount && activeLoan == 0
    then do
      let newState = state
            { lsBalances = Map.adjust (\b -> b - amount) addr (lsBalances state)
            }
      writeIORef stateRef newState
      return (Right ())
    else return (Left "Cannot withdraw with active loan")

-- Entry point: parse and execute uploaded transaction batch
executeUpload :: IORef LoanState -> [TxAction] -> IO (Either String ())
executeUpload = processBlock
